body:
- **Every actionable request from the user becomes a task before any code changes.** Bug, feature, refactor, polish, doc edit, infra change, dependency bump — anything that produces a diff or a deploy. Capture it first in `docsi/TASKS.md` (or the relevant `docsi/*_PLAN.md` if one exists for that feature area) under the appropriate milestone or backlog section, with full filemark sigils: `(milestone-or-project)`, `!priority`, `^task-…` ID, `after:` deps if known.
- **Order of operations:** (1) write the task line in the right `docsi/*.md` file, (2) only then implement, (3) flip to `[/]` while in progress, (4) `[x]` =YYYY-MM-DD on completion. The TASKS file is the running log of what was done and why.
- If the request is exploratory ("what could we…?", "should we…?") it stays a discussion until the user gives an imperative. Only then capture-as-task and implement.
- Tiny one-line edits the user clearly wants done in the same breath (`fix typo`, `bump version`) can skip the task-first step. Use judgement — if it's worth a commit, it's probably worth a task.
- Mirror also into the in-conversation `TaskCreate` tool when the work needs multi-step tracking (e.g. multiple files, multiple builds), so progress is visible inside the session too.
